title: Home Video Templates to Recreate | AIVideosUGC
description: Browse a home scene and rebuild it around the product you sell. Pick the template, add your photo, and download a clip you can post in minutes.
h1: Home Video Templates You Can Recreate
lead: Browse a home scene and rebuild it around the product you sell. Pick the template, add the photo, and download a clip you can post.
steps_h2: How to Make a Home Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Shoppers see one clear change, which is what sells the product.

steps.d: Upload the product photo, with the edges in frame. That photo is what the scene should show.
Describe the scene in one plain line. A voice can read that line over the clip.
Download a 9:16 clip for the phone and a 1:1 still for the product page.

faq.q: What is a home video template?
faq.a: It is a ready-made scene with the shot, the pace, and the line already framed. Add your product and get a clip in minutes, without filming.

faq.q: How does the template become a video I can post?
faq.a: Use the product photo, set one line, and export a tall clip. A shopper sees the product in the scene without a tour of the whole room.

faq.q: Why use this instead of filming a creator at home?
faq.a: It is faster and costs less than asking someone to film inside a home. The listing photo is enough.
Shops that sell for the home and need one clear change on camera. The person who packs orders can make it.

faq.q: Can a beginner make this video?
faq.a: Yes. Pick the scene and add the product photo. You do not need an editing background.
Products that stay large in the frame. A wide shot of a whole room hides the item you sell.

faq.q: Can I start from my own photo, a clip, and a logo?
faq.a: Yes. The photo on your listing is the right start. A short clip and a logo can go in the frame too.
Yes. A Story wants 9:16, at 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. The product page can take 1:1. A wide screen can take 16:9.

faq.q: Do I need a paid plan to make this video?
faq.a: Yes. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A photo spends 24 credits. A video spends 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

faq.q: Can I run this as an ad or as client work?
faq.a: Yes. Run it as an ad and put the same file on the product page, including work you deliver for a client. The file has no watermark.

faq.q: Why start from a template instead of building the ad yourself?
faq.a: The scene and the order of the shot are already there. You bring the product photo and the offer you want said.

steps.prompt: A hand slides this dark gray adjustable divider tray into an open kitchen drawer. The camera looks down and follows the tray in one slow move. Bright window light shows the gray compartments. The last shot shows the full tray fitted in the drawer. You hear the drawer slide and a light utensil clink. Add background music if you want it. Keep the tray's shape, color, and label as in your photo.

definition.title: What Is a Home Video Template?
paras: A home video template is a scene that is already framed. You add the product photo and a line about the one change a shopper should see.
You can edit the line, the captions, and the music before you download. The person on screen, if you use one, is an AI actor.

reasons.h2: Why a Template Beats Starting Blank
reasons.lead: A product that arrived this week can be in an ad without borrowing a room.

items.d: The scene runs from the product photo you already have, so you skip the crew and the location.

items.t: Credits Instead of a Shoot Fee
items.d: Money you do not spend on a crew can go to ads. Each clip spends credits on the plan you already pay for.

items.t: More Than One Cut to Test
items.d: Make one cut and a second crop from the same photo. Keep the one you want to spend on.

items.t: Change the Line and Run It Again
items.d: Update a size or a feature in the script and run it again. A spec change does not mean a new shoot.

items.t: No Wait on a Creator Calendar
items.d: The scene is ready when the product is. You are not waiting on a creator.

items.t: You Bring the Product and the Offer
items.d: You choose the product and the line you want said. The scene is already built.

more_sections.h2: Tools That Finish a Home Ad
more_sections.lead: Voice, captions, music, and publishing stay with the scene, so the ad can be finished here.

items.d: A stock voice can say the one change out loud.
The line can sit on screen so the clip still reads when the phone is on mute. You can move those captions.
One product photo can become a tall ad and a square crop for the listing.
Paste the product page and the scene can use the photo already on it.

items.t: A Script for the One Change
items.d: A short line can be drafted for you, and you can edit the words.

items.t: An AI Actor Shows the Product
items.d: An AI actor can show the product in the scene, so you do not film it yourself.
A track from the music library can sit under the clip.
Cut the clip so the product is visible when the line appears.
The same scene can run in a language you sell in, with the spoken line and the captions switched.
The file can go to TikTok, Facebook, or Instagram, or you can download it for the product page.
Shop software can send product photos in when a catalog needs many clips.
